156: Here, is it his Torah: It is in wonderment (given that the Aramaic phrase can also be read as a statement): The honor is dependent on the Torah, and he cannot forgo the honor of the Torah, since it belongs to the Holy One, blessed be He!

"And in his Torah he meditates": "But his delight is in the Torah of the Lord, and in his Torah he meditates" (Psalms 1:2). At first, it is called the Torah of God; but from when he studies it and reviews it, it is called his Torah.
